flagged.evidence: The statement introduces “v_1,...,v_n∈M” but defines the coordinate matrix using “(v_0,...,v_{n-1})”. The zero-indexed list is undeclared in this clause, so the matrix and basis conclusion do not refer to the listed spanning vectors.

Statement 2 asserts that matrix rank is preserved under a field extension F⊂E, while the locator names “Theorem 5.14 ... comparison of tensor rank and linear-map rank.” Theorem 5.14 characterizes the rank of a linear map by the minimum number of elementary tensors representing it; it does not establish rank preservation under field extension, the item’s rank assertion.
